profile.Name: Daymond the Treacherous
profile.Personality: Proud of the Deadcat's lost greatness and set on restoring it. He hates the cannibals but is open to deals with outsiders who might help.
profile.Backstory: He leads the Deadcat from Deadcatun. He calls the Deadcat a forgotten empire whose power was once grand until the cannibals thrived and overwhelmed it, and he vows to re-establish its hegemony.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Greets outsiders with startled questions that trail off, and calls them 'outlander'.
